versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of dataify-instagram-comment-by-posturl.

- Submit Dataify tasks to collect Instagram post comments by post URL.
- Handles API TOKEN management, including prompting the user to save their token as DATAIFY_API_TOKEN.
- Supports submitting single or multiple post URLs for bulk comment collection.
- Parameter confirmation and editing before submission via Markdown table.
- Provides instructions for viewing results and troubleshooting common issues.
